_comment: Known-bad state for scripts/ci/check-third-party-notices-fresh.ts (CI job 'Third-Party Notices Freshness').  WHAT THIS IS. src/data/thirdPartyNotices.generated.json is generated (npm run license:notices:generate) but nothing ever ran that generator in CI, so it drifted from the dependency set for over a month with no signal. The entries below are the drift that had ALREADY accumulated when the gate was added on 2026-08-30 -- they are NOT approved omissions. Every name here is a dependency whose disclosure on the shipped /legal/third-party-notices page is currently wrong or missing.  WHY IT EXISTS RATHER THAN JUST FAILING. Two independent things are broken today and both are owned by the separate 'Regenerate third-party notices (blocked by sharp)' task: (1) the drift below, and (2) the generator refuses to write at all, because @img/sharp-libvips-* is allowlist-cleared copyleft with no entry in scripts/security/third-party-notices.pinned.json. Failing on that inherited state would red every open PR at once and blackout the Mergify queue -- the failure mode this repo has already paid for. So the gate fails on anything BEYOND this baseline: new drift (the qrcode-generator@2.0.4 class, a production dependency that shipped undisclosed until a human caught it) is blocked from day one.  MATCHING IS BY PACKAGE NAME, NOT VERSION. A name listed here is excused while it keeps drifting, including if its version moves again. That is deliberate: version-exact matching would red a routine dependency bump that nobody can fix, because the generator cannot write. It also means this baseline is looser than the gate will be once it is emptied.  blockedPinnedNotices holds PLATFORM-INDEPENDENT family roots (see stripPlatformSuffix), not installed package names: npm installs @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 on a laptop and @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64 on an ubuntu runner, and one recorded root has to match both.  HOW TO RETIRE IT. Resolve the pinned-notice gap, run `npm run license:notices:generate`, commit the regenerated file, and set driftingNames and blockedPinnedNotices to []. The gate then becomes an exact assertion. Regenerate the payload for this file with: npx tsx scripts/ci/check-third-party-notices-fresh.ts --emit-baseline  expires is a hard stop, not a suggestion: past that date the gate fails on the inherited drift too. Extend it only deliberately, and record why here.
_ownedBy: Task: Regenerate third-party notices (blocked by sharp)
